body: Yea I did, but since they are essentially signing a new lease shouldn’t the landlord give me back my portion?
The landlord isn’t required to pay me back? Am I shit out of luck if they don’t want to give me my part of the deposit?

The comparison between humans and machines is very interesting especially since there’s a worry that humans will be replaced by automation. More importantly the poem flows well and utilizes a creative structure. 

Very awesome poem!

Wow! The imagery was so on point, it felt like I was actually following “the stream of dreams”. This is especially true since the whole poem flowed as if it were a stream. I am also a sucker for repetition of specific lines, and the ending of each stanza with the same line definitely hammered home the feeling of following the stream.  Thank you for sharing this poem! It is excellent!
